headline: European soccer live updates: Manchester United visit Fulham
description: Sunday's action continues with Manchester United out to end a run of two straight losses at Fulham, who are yet to win in the Premier League this season.

headline: Dominic Calvert-Lewin fails to match 23-year Premier League goal record for Leeds
description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin was denied the chance to make a small piece of Elland Road history in Leeds' goalless home draw with Crystal Palace.

headline: Erling Haaland sets unique goal milestone as Man City beat Sunderland
description: Erling Haaland scored the eighth goal of the game as Manchester City beat Sunderland but it gave him a unique personal record.

headline: Man City down Sunderland in eight-goal thriller
description: Brian Brobbey scored a hat trick in a losing cause as Manchester City maintained their 100% Premier League start with a frantic 5-3 win over Sunderland.

headline: Leeds and Crystal Palace battle to gritty goalless draw
Alexander Isak winner for Liverpool on Andoni Iraola return to Bournemouth
description: Alexander Isak's second-half strike secured Liverpool boss Andoni Iraola all three points on his return to the Vitality Stadium in a 1-0 victory over his old club Bournemouth.
